key_step: Odd power m on pair zeros -> prod(z_i-z_j)^m; plasma analogy = uniform screened liquid; flux insertion -> e/m quasihole. All in Laughlin 1983 primary.
evidence: If I multiply each pair factor by itself three times, then every pair coincidence becomes a third-order zero

key_step: NSP ablation confound: 'no NSP hurts' also shortened input; test single-sentence vs segment-pair with NSP on. From paper Sec 4.2; fairseq only gives head code.
evidence: the original "no NSP hurts" result becomes suspect, because that ablation likely shortened the input at the same time

key_step: Differentiate outputs (not loss) wrt inputs -> Jacobian; two-sided gated product saliency; single-feature gate too strict -> pairs; saturate theta=1. Primary.
evidence: the both-signs gate, applied per feature, is so restrictive that very few features survive

key_step: Rows of (I-Q)^-1 as features so (I-Q) cancels in TD update and w*=h; learn M by vector-valued TD. All in Dayan 1993; Gershman only modernizes notation.
evidence: I am exposing the resolvent of the transition process as the representation, so the value learner sees a transformed problem whose optimal weights are memoryless rewards

key_step: Least-L2-norm rep -> d*a=0; closed+coclosed = Laplacian; Green operator I=H+Delta G. Hodge primary NOT retrieved; textbook proof from Demailly/Lim.
evidence: the least-norm representative, if it exists, should be orthogonal to every exact form

key_step: Softmax sums to 1 -> surplus dumped on always-visible initial tokens; evicting them renormalizes -> keep 4 sinks + window, in-cache positions. All in paper.
evidence: the arithmetic says it's about them being the denominator's anchor, and the moment the anchor goes, the whole distribution snaps to a shape the model never saw in training

key_step: (I-P) singular at gamma=1 -> pair (g,h): telescoping gives Poisson eq; Laurent expansion forces same h. Howard/Blackwell via Mahadevan (primary unobtainable).
evidence: the constant term of the Laurent expansion plays the part of the bias

key_step: Adjacency enc order-dependent -> path encoding; exponential length -> prove long paths rare, truncate; ensemble std + ITS + mutate-best pool. Primary+appendix.
evidence: the encoding is well-defined per architecture, the isomorphism ambiguity is gone by construction

key_step: Try to refute REACH<=qfp coREACH; a qfp has only positions+a count, so spelling it out builds the counting certificate. Only in 2024 self-account, not primary.
evidence: Here is where the attempted refutation turns into a construction. A transformation this weak has almost no room to look at the graph itself

key_step: Primes dense relative to pseudorandom almost-prime majorant (W-tricked Lambda_R^2); transference via linear-forms conds. In primary intro; Green 2005 agrees.
evidence: I do not need the primes to be dense in the integers; I need them to be dense relative to a larger sparse object that is itself random enough for progression counting

key_step: u0=a0^(N_l-1) forces per-layer scale exactly 1; Gaussian preserves norm only on average (product spectrum kurtotic) -> isometry. Saxe primary; Mezzadri=QR sign.
evidence: average preservation really is too weak, and the gap is not a constant-factor nuisance — it is exponential in depth

key_step: L1/L2 head collapses bimodal demos to invalid mean/median -> diffusion, eps-pred, DDIM, cosine. OFT primary is thin recipe; WHY from DDPM/DDIM/DiffPolicy.
evidence: both point estimators output 0 — the one value that is *not* in the data and is precisely the collision

key_step: Topology-only pooling provably 2-CC: keep every other BFS frontier so each dropped node has a kept parent, then A^2 restrict; contacts via A A^C A. From paper.
evidence: every dropped odd-depth node d has a BFS parent at depth d-1, which is even and kept — that parent is the kept material neighbor

key_step: DFT needs only exact-order-n element with 1-w^K!=0 -> Z_p, n|p-1 (Pollard); psi-weighting flips wrap sign for x^n+1, merged into CT/GS (Longa-Naehrig).
evidence: There is no analysis here — no limits, no continuity, no magnitude. The complex numbers were never essential

key_step: Large-rate 3x3 atrous degenerates to 1x1 (valid taps->1/9) -> add image-level pooling branch; rates scale with output stride. Primary; TF code fixes layout.
evidence: a single overgrown rate gives me a `1x1`, not a global view

key_step: Poison subpopulation adds rank-one eps(1-eps)Delta Delta^T bump, amplified in learned features -> top singular vector of per-label centered matrix. In primary.
evidence: a small shifted subpopulation adds a rank-one bump in the direction of the mean gap

key_step: KL-projection improvement proof needs only pi_old in Pi -> restricted Gaussian actor OK; reparam pathwise grad; alpha as dual variable. In SAC v1/v2 primaries.
evidence: it only used that pi_old is itself a member of Pi and so is always a candidate the argmin can fall back to

key_step: Halve depth not width so teacher tensors fit student -> init from teacher layer slice; triple loss soft-CE(T^2)+MLM+cos. In paper; only HF-code details added.
evidence: Keeping the dimensions matched is what makes this copy possible at all: if I'd shrunk the width, the teacher tensors wouldn't fit

key_step: One-step diamond fails under duplicating substitution -> parallel reduction (Tait/Martin-Lof). Textbook proof; primary not retrieved; sources = history only.
evidence: Substitution is exactly what breaks the naive one-step diamond

key_step: Majorize only f, keep g exact -> prox_{tg}(y - t grad f); FISTA t-recurrence and anchor forced by potential telescoping. All in Beck-Teboulle Lemma 2.3/4.1.
evidence: the coefficient bookkeeping only closes if t_{k+1}^2 - t_{k+1} = t_k^2

key_step: Model already recognizes harm -> push human to written principles; SL critique->revision fixes RL exploration; CoT labels collapse -> clamp 40-60%. In paper.
evidence: CoT buys better *accuracy* but destroys *calibration*

key_step: Keep 'path = few contiguous ranges' but make chains mutable: depth-keyed splay + one-way path-parent; u-v non-monotone -> make_root = access+reverse. ST83/85.
evidence: a non-monotone sequence cannot live in one depth-keyed splay tree at all

key_step: Fine-tuned weights barely move so magnitude prunes by pretraining -> score movement from zero; STE gives dL/dS=dL/dW*W, sign + swap lemma. All in paper.
evidence: in transfer learning, magnitude pruning can't *learn what to prune* from the fine-tuning step

key_step: Prefix-free 2^-|p| summable (Kraft); mixture over all consistent programs, not shortest: toy shows 2^-K gives P=0 vs 0.2. Textbook + own toy; primary unread.
evidence: the two rules agree up to a constant on the mass but give genuinely different predictions: `0.2` versus `0` for the next bit

key_step: Matching principle binds only encoder input -> decouple context sampler (recent) from RL sampler (buffer); product-of-Gaussians; z/episode = PSRL. In primary.
evidence: The data that trains the encoder need not be the data that trains the policy

key_step: Bias/variance unrolling (Bach) forces sum a=inf, sum a^2<inf; bridge 'minimize F = root of E[grad Q]' turns Robbins-Monro into SGD (Bottou/BCN: RM not gradient)
evidence: The root-finding problem and the optimization problem are the same problem, with `alpha = 0` and the noisy response being the single-example gradient
